fields.Name: T210 - Record Change History
fields.Description: Opens a record's Record Changes History panel (MJ built-in versioning/audit) and verifies the change log displays.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. In the record toolbar (the row of icons at the TOP-LEFT, just above the Details card), click the History control — the CLOCK icon whose tooltip reads "N version(s) tracked". Verify the "Record Changes History" panel opens and lists the record's change entries (each entry shows an action such as 'X changed', the user, and a time), or shows a clear empty state if the record has no tracked changes yet. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The record's History control (clock icon / 'N version(s) tracked') in the toolbar was clicked
A 'Record Changes History' panel opened listing change entries (action + user + time), or a clear empty state
No error messages or crash pages
